title: Cameo is Running Deals for Mother’s Day On Custom Videos From Your Favorite Musicians
summary: Here's everything you need to know about the musicians on Cameo and their pricing.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

So your significant other is obsessed with *NSYNC . What better way to celebrate a birthday, anniversary and everything in between with videos from Lance Bass,  Joey Fatone or Chris Kirkpatrick?

Cameo is a website with all different types of entertainers — musicians, actors, models, reality stars and YouTubers — and they all have different prices. For whatever their price is, ranging anywhere from $5 to $999, fans can pay for a personalized video from their favorite personality. You can also use Cameo for business videos for your company, employees or customers.

The site allows you to enter a prompt and pick the length of the video message. Pricing often depends on the length of the video and who you’re requesting. Right now, Cameo is running a Mother’s Day sale on certain people’s pricing. This is a pretty easy gifting option, especially considering that sometimes video messages can be sent within a few days. You want a specific lyric sung? Maybe you want your favorite musician to sing you ” Happy Birthday ” or give you an encouraging message to help you or your loved one get through a hard time. Whatever you want, within reason, is usually doable. 

Some of our favorite musicians that you can currently request from include  Flavor Flav , Riff Raff , Ne-Yo , Vic Mensa , Snoop Dogg , Ice T, Sugar Ray’s Mark McGrath and even Bluey Heeler or Bingo Heeler from the hit show Bluey . I was gifted a Cameo for three years straight on Christmas and each time, I was blown away knowing my favorite musicians knew who I was, at least for a brief second. 

With so much to choose from off the site , ShopBillboard has decided to round up a bunch of our favorites that can currently be found on the platform, along with their price, so if you’re in the market for the ultimate, personal holiday gift, take a look below.
